violations.text: The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. Management's plan for assessing, monitoring, and controlling foodborne disease hazards is inadequate. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

Beef and tomato soup observed held at 92-105 degrees Fahrenheit on the shelf above the stove. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Beef was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Cooked carrots were placed hot in plastic containers greater than four inches deep. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Working containers of dry ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (top of the ice machine) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
Knives observed stored in the crack between the 3 bay sink and the wall. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Clean linens observed stored unprotected in the basement storage area. Clean equipment, utensils, and single service items must be stored in a clean dry location, where they are not subject to dust, splash, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the dishwashers and 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the wire shelves in the kitchen, the sheet pan rack, walk in shelves, stove, grill, and fryer have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
Menu is lacking an allergy statement. English Food Allergies What You Need to Know English Food Allergy Reactions New Violation. Correct By: 03/17/2024
Shellstock tags did not have all of the required information. The dates of last use were lacking. New Violation. Correct By: 03/07/2024

Raw animal foods (such as assorted meats) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as wine) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from ready to eat foods during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/07/2024

Working containers of numerous dry ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 03/07/2024

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the basement back storage area. New Violation. Correct By: 03/07/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: mandolin can opener prep units sheet pan rack grill area beneath grill New Violation. Correct By: 03/07/2024
The grease recycling bin and surrounding area has an accumulation of grease. New Violation. Correct By: 03/17/2024
The fan covers in the walk in cooler have an accumulation of dust and debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 03/07/2024
